description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for actor components in a messaging system, particularly related to connectivity and message consumption within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes common fields, resource status management, message forwarding, acknowledgement handling, and logging, serving as a foundation for more specialized consumer actor implementations.

classes.name: BaseConsumerActor
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for messaging consumer actors within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including status handling, message forwarding, acknowledgement processing, and resource management.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the logging adapter for the actor.

methods.name: forwardToMappingActor
methods.description: Sends an external message to the mapping processor actor and handles acknowledgement logic, including redelivery decisions based on responses.

methods.name: forwardToMappingActor
methods.description: Overloaded method to send an error message to the mapping processor actor.

methods.name: resetResourceStatus
methods.description: Resets the internal resource status to indicate the actor has started executing.

methods.name: getCurrentSourceStatus
methods.description: Returns the current resource status of this source, including its connectivity status and details.

methods.name: handleAddressStatus
methods.description: Updates the resource status based on the provided resource status, handling unknown resource types.

methods.name: forwardAndAwaitAck
methods.description: Sends a message to the mapping processor actor and waits for acknowledgement responses within configured timeouts.

methods.name: addSourceAndReplyTarget
methods.description: Creates a new external message with added source and reply target headers.

methods.name: enrichHeadersWithReplyInformation
methods.description: Enrichs message headers with reply target information if available.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance identifier for the system.

methods.name: someFailedResponseRequiresRedelivery
methods.description: Determines if any failed response indicates a need for redelivery.

methods.name: extractAggregatedResponses
methods.description: Extracts individual responses from potentially grouped acknowledgement responses.

methods.name: requiresRedelivery
methods.description: Decides whether an acknowledgement or exception requires redelivery based on its status code.
